title: Welcome to UWEC demos
content:
This catalog bundles layout switchers, UI tropes, maps, galleries, checklists, and design playgrounds in one flat static site.

Start at index.html and use the browser back button between demos.

title: Module highlights
content:
Try demo-layout-switcher.html for six layout modes, demo-ui-components.html for cards/tabs/modals, and demo-maps-choropleth.html for coloured country groups.

Login as Demo Admin to preview the admin panel shell.

title: Static-first architecture
content: Every module runs on GitHub Pages: HTML + CSS + JSON seed data. Interactive pieces persist in localStorage so you can add posts, markers, checklist items, and comments without a server.

title: Design playground
content: Font tables, menu styles, ornaments, tessellation patterns, gradient generator, and a live CSS editor live under Design Demos on the landing page.

title: Travel & connections
content: Holiday planner, Caribbean route matrix, and choropleth maps show how JSON-driven modules can cover niche domains — airlines, ferries, trip dossiers, and regional highlights.
